sources.revision: Current 3DSOLID and BODY reference pages accessed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: 3DSOLID lists AcDbModelerGeometry, group 70, group-1 proprietary text with group-3 continuation when group 1 exceeds 255 characters, then AcDb3dSolid and soft-owner group 350. BODY's current table lists the modeler subclass/version/payload without the 3DSOLID history pair.
sources.limits: The current tables establish field names/roles and the published text boundary, but do not state the historical release in which AcDb3dSolid/group 350 became part of the 3DSOLID DXF sequence.

sources.revision: Public PR refreshed 2026-10-20; head shown as 098d7a3, open, no deployments/reviews.
sources.observed: The branch reports R2007 as the AcDb3dSolid/history start, proposes cutting SAT text at the last fitting space so tokens do not span group-1/3 values, and author-reports TrueView checks at R2000/R2004/R2007/R2010/R2013 in both formats except that R2007 DWG writing is unsupported. On Oct 1 the author reported that after the Prototype_1b refactor DXF ACDSDATA reading retains only the last group-310 chunk; the maintainer preferred schema-aware AcDs writing and left the branch as a reference.
sources.limits: This is unmerged branch behavior and author/maintainer commentary, not released capability or an independently reproduced acceptance result. The ACDSDATA 310 issue is separate from legacy SAT group-1/3 chunking.

sources.revision: LibreDWG mutable NEWS, ezdxf v1.4.4 pinned source, and docs.rs generated serializer page accessed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: LibreDWG release notes state support for AcDb3dSolid history_id at r2007+; ezdxf's pinned DXF writer gates the subclass/history pair after DXF2004; the published Rust dxf serializer writes the subclass and group 350 at AcadVersion::R2007.
sources.limits: These are implementation sources, not Autodesk's historical change log. The docs.rs generated serializer URL is build-generated and should be treated as a dated observation rather than a durable release-source permalink.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw source and generated test crosswalk
sources.revision: Read-only source/test inspection on 2026-10-20; no code changed or executed.
sources.observed: Current SAT group-1/3 output uses a 255-byte capacity, preserving SAT-v1 caret-space pairs but otherwise allowing an ASCII token to cross a chunk boundary. Current writer gates AcDb3dSolid/group 350 to AC1021+ 3DSOLID and rejects nonzero history for older versions or other modeler entity types. Existing generated tests cover 254/255/256 and 509/510/511 lengths, spaces/token-crossing, ASCII/Binary, local reconstruction, remapping, and refusal.
sources.limits: Generated local round-trip proves only local serialization/reconstruction and version policy; it does not establish independent parser or native-application acceptance of the chunk boundary.
